name: Neighbour Nell
bio: Your first neighbour in Hearthwick, back when it was one hut and a lot of trees. Keeps the Town Journal.

portrait.subject: a cute cheerful village woman with rosy cheeks, a headscarf, an apron with a leather journal tucked in the pocket and a small axe
portrait.background: cosy cartoon village clearing with huts and tall trees

request: Hello hello! Nell, your neighbour in Hearthwick. Friends? I've got a journal entry ready! 🏘️
hello: Lovely! I'll write you in the Town Journal!
Tap the trees for wood. Then we build!
about: I'm Nell! I was your very first neighbour. I keep the Town Journal. Every chapter we finish, the town gets bigger!
how: Tap trees for wood and stone, build a Woodshed, give villagers jobs and follow the Town Journal chapter by chapter for rewards and Renown.
tips: Finish journal entries. They pay out!
Give every villager a job. Idle hands, idle town.
chat: Wrote three pages today. All about a squirrel.
The baker's new oven smells amazing.
We have a well now! Splash!
A traveller asked for directions. I gave them a tour.
nudge: New journal chapter's ready! Come read?
The villagers have ideas! Come listen!
idle: The villagers gathered resources for {ago}! The storehouse is full! 🏘️
{ago}! I wrote a whole chapter while you were away.
{game} has some wood and gold waiting for you! The town worked hard for {ago}.
progress: We have {gold} gold in the coffers! Something nice to build?
update: Town Journal: Hearthwick is now v{version}!
